reviewer: Codex direct review + independent Astra review

findings.description: Direct inspection of front, back, side and three-quarter views shows asymmetric overskirt drape: one side lifts while the other collapses into angular folds. Both side profiles show doubled and stacked lilac hem segments. The trim does not yet read as one continuous edge around both hips.

Irregular gray patches remain visible through the white chest and waist in neutral, arms-up and arm-cross renders. The source is unresolved; the images do not distinguish clearance/intersection from exposed source surface or shading.

In crouch and sit, both shorts-clad thighs project through the front of the overskirt while its center panel hangs behind them. The lower skirt silhouette and thigh clearance remain unacceptable in bent-leg poses.

nextAction: Keep V171 rejected. Correct the overskirt asymmetric drape and doubled hem trim, identify and remove the bodice chest/waist artifacts, and fix front panel deformation/clearance over both thighs in crouch and sit. Compare matched renders with V170. Regenerate and directly inspect all eleven previews. Numeric fit, Shape Key response, Unity/VRChat execution, packaging, and release remain unverified.
